hypothesis: The fixed 500-global-merge hybrid preserves a lower aggregate trilingual token-cost Gini than Classical BPE on a second untouched aligned domain, FLORES-200 devtest.

source.selection: all aligned public devtest rows, expected 1012; no row filtering after text access
source.access_boundary: Plan frozen before archive download or any sentence text inspection. FLORES+ Hub files returned HTTP 401 without accepted gated access and will not be used or bypassed.

primary_contrast.metric: Gini of the three per-language mean token counts
primary_contrast.direction: positive supports scoped transfer; zero/negative does not

uncertainty.scope: descriptive; article clusters unavailable in the public text bundle

decision_rule: Report the point estimate and 95% paired bootstrap interval regardless of sign. Do not tune or replace codes after outcome access.
information_fairness: All fixed models were trained before this source was selected; this domain is confirmation-only.
compute_fairness: Same fixed 1000-merge/1256-vocabulary models, byte-level plus whitespace pretokenization, one process and explicit numeric/tokenizer thread caps.
limitations: Three Latin-script languages and convenience training frame; not an original-paper reproduction, not broad multilingual inference, and sentence bootstrap may understate article-level dependence.
